extracted.name: All Day Venison Pot Roast
extracted.description: This all-day venison pot roast recipe with onions, carrots, and portobellos is slow-cooked with a creamy mushroom, dry onion, and beef broth gravy.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (1.25 ounce) envelope dry onion gravy mix
instruction_lines: Arrange carrots, onions, and mushrooms in a slow cooker. Rub venison roast with garlic, black pepper, and salt; place on top of vegetables.
Combine soup, beef broth, water, and gravy mix until gravy mix is dissolved; pour over roast. Cover slow cooker.
Cook on High setting until roast is very tender, 8 to 10 hours. Slice roast; serve with gravy and vegetables.
